audit.why: Singed / Singed / Skill / Master Yi / Master Yi / Master Yi / Master Yi matches the packet chart, the 46.25% win rate and every why on the page — Singed owns the item-less levels and loses everything after Yi's first item. No flips needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect confirmed: zero cooldown-sequencing on the page. Alpha Strike is treated as a permanent Fling-dodge and Highlander as an unconditional stick.
audit.why: Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18 — a very long cooldown for a dodge tool, so the answer is to Fling inside the gap, not to stop Flinging. Highlander is 85s. Meditate is 10s.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike 20s at rank 1; Highlander 85s; Meditate 10s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four interactions are absent. (a) Alpha Strike is a dash, so Mega Adhesive grounds it — from inside the goo he cannot use it to dodge anything. (b) Meditate is a channel, and Fling cancels channels outright. (c) Highlander grants immunity to slows, which voids Rylai's and the Mega Adhesive slow — but a root is not a slow, so the Fling-into-goo landing still holds him. (d) Wuju Style is true damage, so the page's instinct to out-tank him is wrong at the itemisation level.
audit.why: Riot Alpha Strike: 'Master Yi teleports across the battlefield... becoming untargetable.' Riot Mega Adhesive: 'slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.' Riot Meditate: 'Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind' — channel flag on the kit, and Riot Fling is a hard displacement. Riot Highlander: 'making him immune to all slowing effects.' Riot Wuju Style: 'Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.' The slow-immunity-versus-root distinction is the one that decides whether Singed has any answer at all after level 6.
audit.corrected: Goo grounds Alpha Strike; Fling cancels Meditate; Highlander ignores your slows but not the Fling-landing root; build health, not armour, against true damage.

edits.after: Alpha Strike is untargetable but 20s at rank 1 — Fling him inside that gap.

edits.before: Take the first two levels for everything they hold: proxy and poison him before his damage exists, and let Poison Trail plus the Fling threat out-pressure his item-less kit. By 3 Alpha Strike starts dodging Fling and his shred ramps — that is your cue to stop fighting and start running the map.
edits.after: Take the first two levels for everything they hold: proxy and poison him before his damage exists, and let Poison Trail plus the Fling threat out-pressure his item-less kit. By 3 Alpha Strike goes untargetable through your Fling — but it is 20s at rank 1 and Mega Adhesive grounds it, so drop the goo first.

edits.before: From his first item on he simply out-duels and out-splits you — his shred melts your tank faster than poison hurts him. So never be alone: split only with escape routes and teleport, Fling him into your team when he dives, and turn every fight he wants into a 1v5 he cannot reset through.
edits.after: From his first item on he out-duels and out-splits you — Wuju Style is true damage, so armour buys you nothing. Never be alone: split only with escape routes and teleport, Fling him into your team when he dives, and use that same Fling to cancel Meditate, which is a channel and breaks outright.
